ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption shadow-copy wipe + boot-recovery sabotage chain
ucs.description: Detects the canonical LockBit (aka LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0, CrowdStrike BITWISE SPIDER) immediate-pre-detonation sequence: vssadmin/wmic shadowcopy delete, wbadmin catalog wipe, and the distinctive bcdedit boot-failure-ignore + recoveryenabled No pair. This back-to-back combination on one host within seconds is signature LockBit affiliate playbook from the leaked builder and CISA #StopRansomware advisories.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") AND (Processes.process="*shadow*delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*stop SQLWriter*" OR Processes.process="*stop VSS*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user host _time span=5m | where distinct_bins >= 2 | rename Processes.* as * | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe")
| extend Sig = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shadow","shadowcopy","shadowstorage") and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "vss_wipe",
    ProcessCommandLine has "wbadmin" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"), "wbadmin_wipe",
    ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" and ProcessCommandLine has "ignoreallfailures", "bcd_ignorefail",
    ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "No", "bcd_norecover",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b(stop|delete|config)\s+(SQLWriter|VSS|MSSQLSERVER|BackupExec|Veeam|MemTas|mepocs|sophos|svc\$)", "svc_kill",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Sig)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Signals = make_set(Sig), SignalCount = dcount(Sig),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 12),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 6)
  by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where SignalCount >= 2     // 2+ distinct sabotage signals in 10 min = LockBit pre-detonation
| order by LastSeen desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadow*delete* OR *delete*shadows* OR *shadowstorage* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *recoveryenabled*No* OR *recoveryenabled*no*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin|bcdedit|net1?|sc|powershell)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(shadow.*delete|delete.*shadows|shadowstorage|delete\s+catalog|delete\s+systemstatebackup|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+No|stop\s+(SQLWriter|VSS|Veeam|BackupExec|MSSQLSERVER))", field=CommandLine)
| LockBitSig := if(regex("(?i)shadow.*delete|delete.*shadows|shadowstorage", field=CommandLine), then="vss", else=if(regex("(?i)wbadmin.*(delete\s+catalog|delete\s+systemstatebackup|delete\s+backup)", field=CommandLine), then="wbadmin", else=if(regex("(?i)bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", field=CommandLine), then="bcd_ignore", else=if(regex("(?i)recoveryenabled\s+No", field=CommandLine), then="bcd_norecover", else="svc_kill"))))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=events), collect([LockBitSig, CommandLine], multival=true), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| distinct_sigs := length(LockBitSig)
| distinct_sigs >= 2
ucs.rationale: Generic 'vssadmin delete shadows' detections fire on legitimate backup tools and AV cleanup. What pins this to LockBit (BITWISE SPIDER) specifically is the 2+ signal correlation within 10 minutes: LockBit's binary and its affiliate batch scripts (leaked LockBit 3.0 builder + CISA AA23-325A) chain shadow-wipe + wbadmin catalog delete + the highly distinctive bcdedit bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailur

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate Rclone exfiltration to MEGA/pCloud immediately before encryption
ucs.description: Detects LockBit's signature double-extortion staging: rclone.exe (often renamed svchost.exe, w.exe, or s.exe) executed with a MEGA/pCloud/AnyFiles remote config, dragging gigabytes of file-share content to LockBit's data-leak infrastructure before the encryptor runs. The rclone+MEGA combination is the most-reported affiliate exfil pattern in LockBit incidents (Mandiant, CrowdStrike BITWISE SPIDER reporting, NCC Group).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*rclone*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" AND (Processes.process="*mega*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud*" OR Processes.process="*--no-check-certificate*" OR Processes.process="*copy*remote:*" OR Processes.process="*sync*remote:*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*ftp.*" OR Processes.process="*anyfiles*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name host | rename Processes.* as * | join type=left dest [| tstats summariesonly=true values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port dc(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.app="rclone" OR All_Traffic.process_name="rclone.exe" OR All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,21,2222,8080)) by All_Traffic.src host | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.* as *] | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let MegaPCloudInfra = dynamic(["mega.co.nz","mega.nz","megaupload.com","userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs.mega.nz","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","anyfiles.net","steamcommunity.app","file.io"]);
let RcloneCmd = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone","--config","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","copy remote:","sync remote:","--no-check-certificate","--ignore-existing","--max-age"))
        and (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega","pcloud","anyfiles","ftp","sftp","webdav","s3:","backblaze","b2:") 
             or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b(copy|sync|move)\s+\\\\")
    | extend RcloneIndicator = case(
        FileName =~ "rclone.exe", "named_rclone",
        ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe", "renamed_rclone",
        ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone", "renamed_rclone",
        "cmdline_match")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, OriginalName=ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName, ProductName=ProcessVersionInfoProductName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, RcloneIndicator, SHA256;
let RcloneNet = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
             or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
             or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone"
             or RemoteUrl has_any (MegaPCloudInfra))
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize NetFirst = min(Timestamp), NetLast = max(Timestamp), Bytes = count(), Dests = make_set(RemoteUrl, 10), DestIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 10) by DeviceId;
RcloneCmd
| join kind=leftouter RcloneNet on DeviceId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, OriginalName, ProductName, RcloneIndicator, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256, NetFirst, NetLast, Dests, DestIPs
| order by Timestamp desc

let MegaPCloudInfra = dynamic(["mega.co.nz","mega.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs.mega.nz","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","anyfiles.net","file.io"]);
let RcloneCmd = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
    | extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine), Img = tolower(NewProcessName)
    | where (Cmd has_any ("rclone","--config","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","copy remote:","sync remote:","--no-check-certificate","--ignore-existing"))
        and (Cmd has_any ("mega","pcloud","anyfiles","ftp","sftp","webdav","s3:","b2:"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let RcloneNet = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (MegaPCloudInfra) or RequestURL has_any (MegaPCloudInfra) or SourceProcessName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | summarize NetFirst = min(TimeGenerated), NetLast = max(TimeGenerated), BytesOut = sum(toint(SentBytes)), Dests = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10) by SourceHostName;

| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, NetFirst, NetLast, BytesOut, Dests
| order by TimeGenerated desc
